"Khoobsurat Haseena" is a timeless classic from the 1964 Bollywood film Mr. X In Bombay. Sung by the legendary Kishore Kumar and Lata Mangeshkar, this romantic duet captures the magic of golden-era Bollywood music. The song is a delightful blend of melody and charm, with beautiful lyrics and an unforgettable tune that has made it a favorite across generations.
Song: Khoobsurat Haseena
Singers: Kishore Kumar, Lata Mangeshkar
Music Director: Laxmikant–Pyarelal
Movie: Mr. X In Bombay
Release Year: 1964
Starring: Kishore Kumar, Kum Kum
